snippet.title: MINI Sonic The Hedgehog (1993) :: Walkthrough (1080p/60fps)
snippet.description:
MINI Sonic The Hedgehog is a Fan Game created by Sakai Game Factory.

So for this short game, only one level is implemented. One hidden thing that was note shown here is if you destroy the "?" monitor when holding 100 rings, you will enter a bonus stage. From what I believe, you only get more rings in the bonus stage, there isn't any chaos emeralds here.

Music that was used in the game is from Gemini Wing (Tecmo).

Recommended emulator: XM6 TypeG
An emulator that I have never ever heard of lol, but from doing a bit more research it seems that there is a PS1 version out there, except a few differences on that one is Sonic is red, and there is no audio throughout the game.

The link destination is Japanese language only, but the way I was able to translate it was from a default option on Google Chrome.
